summary: Teledyne Technologies filed an 8-K reporting the Personnel and Compensation Committee's April 21, 2026 approval of modest base salary increases for three named executive officers: CFO Stephen Blackwood to $660k, Vice Chairman Jason VanWees to $613k, and General Counsel Melanie Cibik to $603k, plus enhanced stock option eligibility for Blackwood and Cibik. The filing also describes the shareholder-approved amendment to the 2014 Incentive Award Plan that increases share reserves by 4 million and adjusts the full-value award share counting ratio to 2.45. These are routine compensatory and governance updates, not a forced departure or extraordinary management event.
